meta.title: Partial drawdown, B̄ = 1 (Morgenstern chart)
meta.notes: Homogeneous embankment after a partial drawdown from 100 to 50 ft with B̄ = 1: the piezometric line follows the face above the pool and stays at the pool below it, which loads the submerged face. Converted to SI.

source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V070 (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Morgenstern (1963), example II, p. 130: drawdown to H/2 gives 1.52 (tangent to the base), 1.48 (tangent to H/2) and 1.41 (tangent to H/4, interpolated 1.31 + 0.30/3). The charts are Bishop simplified (Little & Price), γ = 2γw, B̄ = 1 (docs/kallor/morgenstern-1963.md). A duplicated first coordinate was removed 2026-10-25 (no effect).
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
agua embalsada: la piezométrica pasa sobre el terreno; ogs la incluye en todas las versiones, con su peso y su empuje horizontal y sin sismo (F5.3); cSlope la carga con `followBoundary: false`.
